title: Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement Tariff Clause: The Vehicle Swap Fee
content:
**Tariff clause.** The vehicle swap fee on a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement is the vehicle swap fee of the space class, charged in full for the swap, never below zero, and rounded to the cent. The figure is the one shown for the agreement's own space class in the vehicle change terms.

**Reading the clause.**
- One swap, one fee: the fee is posted with each change of the vehicle on file.
- The fee does not depend on the new vehicle's type or length, nor on the rent.
- A renewed registration or insurance for the same vehicle is not a swap and carries no fee.

**Hypothetical illustrations.**

| Agreement | Change requested | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Uncovered Car Space | Sedan replaced by a pickup | $15.00 |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | 24 ft travel trailer replaced by a 27 ft Class C motorhome | $25.00 |
